context_features.industry_mom20: Same signal-date eligible industry mean momentum_20; fewer than 5 finite observations or Unknown industry falls back to universe mean
context_features.industry_rank20: Average-tie rank of momentum_20 within eligible industry: (rank-.5)/n-.5; fewer than 5 finite observations or Unknown falls back to universe rank
context_features.universe_mean_mom20: Equal weight mean of finite momentum_20 among signal-eligible stocks
context_features.universe_breadth20: Fraction of finite eligible momentum_20 strictly above zero
context_features.universe_dispersion20: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of eligible momentum_20

population: Signal-eligible population only, including stocks whose future label is missing. Finite observations only; no target information. Industry mean includes self. These universe proxies are not an external market index.
preprocessing: Ridge: original and added columns use training-only .005/.995 clipping, median fill and population scaling. LightGBM: original 21 use centered same-date cross-sectional ranks then existing training median/scaling; added 12 use raw training-only clipping/fill/scaling, preserving common market context and interactions. No label normalization.
selection: Parent two-window equal-weight mean Rank IC, ties choose first grid entry; choose independently within four designs. Persist every candidate; reuse existing fitted candidates for evaluation and portfolios, no refit.
portfolio_scope: 2020-2021 only, verified corporate action/settlement ledger; original top-decile and round1 constrained portfolios. 2019 prediction metrics only. No portfolio metric used for selection.
